own.notes: For integer quantity q from 1 through 1000, select the segment with the greatest from value not exceeding q. Predict constant + linear*q + quadratic*q^2 in GBP pence, rounded to a nonnegative integer; these coefficients already produce nonnegative integers. This is an all-units model: 3076 pence per unit for quantities 1–140, 1398 for 141–725, and 1018 for 726–1000, not cumulative marginal pricing. Adjacent-integer REA observations confirmed the transitions at 140/141 and 725/726. The predictor exactly matches all 96 distinct observed own-context quantities, including 67 additional validation quantities queried after the model was fixed. Validation achieved 67/67 exact matches and consequently 67/67 within both 1% and 5% relative error; maximum observed error was zero pence. Samples include 1 and 1000, with a maximum gap of 13 between sampled quantities. Confidence is high in this three-tier reconstruction, but the remaining 904 quantities were not observed: their outputs are predictions, and narrow unsampled exceptions cannot be ruled out.
